EXTRAORDINARY
LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) AS
AMEMDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION
(AMENDMENT) ACT NO. 28 OF 1964
Notice under Section 7
My No.: DS/GFG/L&L/5/89.
Ministry of Land and Parliamentary reforms

I hereby give notice, under sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the land described below for Moragoda Ela Development Project.

Description of the land to be acquired : Allotments of land in toal extent 0.2346 hectare depicted as lot 941, 942, 945, 946, 949, 950, 953, 954, 956, 959, 960, 962,964, 966, 968, 969, 971, 973, 975, 978, 979, 982, 984, 985, 988, 989, 992, 993, 996, 997, 1000, 1001, 1004, 1005, 1009, 1010, 1011, 1014, 1015, 1018, 1020, 1021, 1024, 1025, 1026, 1028, 1031, 1032, 1034, 1038, 1039, 1042, 1043, 1044, 1047, 1048, 1050, 1053, 1054, 1057, 1058, 1061, 1062 & 1063 in sheet No. 26 of Block No. 02 of Cadastral Map No. 810024 of 28/06/2016 prepared by the Survey General situated in the village of Deddudoda South in the Grama Niladahari Division No. 101A of Deddudoda South, within the Municipal Council limit of Galle in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Four Gravets Galle in Galle
District of the Southern Province. The names, extents and boundaries of the said allotments of land are as follows.
